description: This source file implements functions for interpreting widget data related to overlays in a Vulkan context, including managing widget types, limits, coordinate transformations, and rendering data for overlay widgets such as text and graphs.

classes.name: OverlayState
classes.description: Manages overlay widget states, including buffer sizes and widget data filling.

classes.name: RunningGraph
classes.description: Represents a graph widget with a series of values for overlay display.

methods.name: fillEnabledWidgetCoordinates
methods.description: Fills buffer with coordinates of enabled widgets, respecting limits and widget types.

methods.name: fillWidgetData
methods.description: Populates text and graph widget data buffers based on current overlay widgets.
